notes: The connector and all Takaro configuration belong on the dedicated server. No Takaro client plugin or custom client RPC is supported.
Live-supported records retain dedicated-server evidence through the artifact-pinned turn-5 run on 2026-07-10. Turn-6 source changes remain pending fresh build and live verification.
getPlayer is implemented by filtering the dedicated server player list, but its final Takaro response shape has not been independently live-proven, so it remains unsupported.

getPlayerLocation uses only a real ready-peer/public observation or a fresh 30-second player-keyed last-known observation. If neither exists, a required-coordinate payload with error is rejected by current Takaro Generic.requestFromServer rather than returned as a position.

getPlayerInventory is permanently unsupported because a dedicated server does not expose remote client inventory components. No response frame is sent: an empty array would be persisted as real state, so current Takaro rejects by its bounded pending-request timeout.
giveItem creates server-owned world drops near the player's server-known position. These are collectible world objects, not a private inventory grant.
teleportPlayer routes Valheim's built-in RPC_TeleportTo to the server-known character ZDO owner.
Inbound vanilla-client chat is unsupported and tracked by https://github.com/gettakaro/connectors/issues/69.
Routed ChatMessage, Say, and OnDeath packets are diagnostic-only because packet-supplied identity and death state are not server-owned. Chat-message and player-death remain unsupported.

Player lifecycle frames are derived from dedicated-server player snapshots. Turn-3 Takaro eventSearch persisted two player-connected and two player-disconnected events; transport logs still claim only that a frame was written, not persistence acknowledgement.

listLocations is schema-fallback: turn 4 live-proved the official raw Generic Connector action/schema with 11293 nested server-owned locations in a 1815046-byte response, but Takaro 0c63cf1c Generic.listLocations throws NotImplementedError, so the standard Takaro route is unavailable pending upstream support.

getMapInfo and getMapTile are part of the exhaustive Takaro 0c63cf1c action list but unsupported at the dedicated-server-only boundary because Valheim exposes neither client map metadata nor rendered map tiles there.
Entity-killed is unsupported and has no active emitter or Harmony death patch.
